sourcedFrom: Deluxe Mark XXII Tubular Model — Undated folded instruction sheet with "PARTS DESCRIPTION FOR MARK XXII TUBULAR MODEL" (PDF p.4)
cleanIntro: The tubular Mark XXII is a .22 LR autoloader fed from a magazine tube under the barrel: an inner tube that unlocks with the knurled knob at its end and pulls out of the outer tube. Its barrel and receiver come out of the stock as one assembly, held by a single takedown pin at the rear of the receiver. Weatherby's sheet takes it that far and no further. Emptying it takes care: the sheet warns that one or two cartridges may stay in the gun after the tube is emptied.

steps.title: Safety on: pulled back so the S shows
steps.action: The safety sits on top of the tang, where your thumb reaches it. Pull it back until the S is exposed. That is SAFE; pushed forward to cover the S, the rifle can fire.
steps.prose: Finger outside the trigger guard and the muzzle pointed somewhere safe for everything that follows.
steps.quote: located conveniently on top of the tang
steps.cite: Deluxe Mark XXII Tubular Model — Undated folded instruction sheet with "PARTS DESCRIPTION FOR MARK XXII TUBULAR MODEL" (PDF p.4) — SAFETY, PDF p.2

steps.title: Inner magazine tube pulled all the way out
steps.action: Turn the knurled knob at the end of the magazine tube to unlock the inner tube, then pull the inner magazine tube completely out of the magazine.
steps.prose: Its spring and follower come out with it. Lay it where it cannot roll.
steps.quote: Pull inner magazine tube completely from magazine.
steps.cite: Deluxe Mark XXII Tubular Model — Undated folded instruction sheet with "PARTS DESCRIPTION FOR MARK XXII TUBULAR MODEL" (PDF p.4) — UNLOADING, PDF p.2

steps.title: Rifle turned over, muzzle tilted down, cartridges shaken out
steps.action: Turn the rifle over and tilt the muzzle slightly downward so the loaded rounds slide slowly out of the magazine. Shake the rifle slightly until every cartridge has come out.
steps.prose: Muzzle down means muzzle at the floor in front of you, never at your feet. Count what comes out against what you loaded.
steps.quote: Turn rifle over and tilt muzzle slightly downward to allow loaded rounds to slide slowly from magazine.
steps.cite: Deluxe Mark XXII Tubular Model — Undated folded instruction sheet with "PARTS DESCRIPTION FOR MARK XXII TUBULAR MODEL" (PDF p.4) — UNLOADING, PDF p.2

steps.title: Inner tube back in the magazine
steps.action: Put the inner magazine tube back into the magazine.
steps.prose: The rifle is not clear yet: the next step is the one the sheet marks CAUTION.
steps.quote: Return inner magazine tube to the magazine.
steps.cite: Deluxe Mark XXII Tubular Model — Undated folded instruction sheet with "PARTS DESCRIPTION FOR MARK XXII TUBULAR MODEL" (PDF p.4) — UNLOADING, PDF p.2

steps.title: Selector on AUTO, bolt worked back - then several more times
steps.action: Put the selector lever on AUTO. Work the bolt backward by hand to extract the round in the chamber, then work it several more times to make certain the gun is empty.
steps.prose: This is the step that finds the cartridge a tube magazine hides. Catch each round that comes out.
steps.quote: Manually work bolt backward to extract the round in the chamber.
steps.cite: Deluxe Mark XXII Tubular Model — Undated folded instruction sheet with "PARTS DESCRIPTION FOR MARK XXII TUBULAR MODEL" (PDF p.4) — UNLOADING, PDF p.2
steps.warn: One or two cartridges may remain in the gun.

steps.title: Look: chamber and action empty
steps.action: Look into the chamber and the action and confirm there is no cartridge in either.
steps.prose: A look, not an assumption. The sheet's disassembly opens with the same words: be sure your rifle is unloaded.
steps.quote: make certain both the chamber and the action are empty at this point.
steps.cite: Deluxe Mark XXII Tubular Model — Undated folded instruction sheet with "PARTS DESCRIPTION FOR MARK XXII TUBULAR MODEL" (PDF p.4) — UNLOADING, PDF p.2

steps.title: Inner magazine tube completely out of the outer tube
steps.action: Take the inner magazine tube completely out of the outer magazine tube again and set it aside.
steps.prose: The barrel and receiver will not lift out with it in place.
steps.quote: Completely remove inner magazine tube from outer magazine tube.
steps.cite: Deluxe Mark XXII Tubular Model — Undated folded instruction sheet with "PARTS DESCRIPTION FOR MARK XXII TUBULAR MODEL" (PDF p.4) — DISASSEMBLY, PDF p.2

steps.title: Takedown pin out, pushed from right to left
steps.action: The takedown pin is at the rear of the receiver. Push it out from the right side toward the left and take it out.
steps.prose: It goes back in from the left, so note which way it came out.
steps.quote: Remove takedown pin (B) at rear of receiver by pushing from right to left
steps.cite: Deluxe Mark XXII Tubular Model — Undated folded instruction sheet with "PARTS DESCRIPTION FOR MARK XXII TUBULAR MODEL" (PDF p.4) — DISASSEMBLY, PDF p.2

steps.title: Barrel pulled forward and lifted: the action comes out of the stock
steps.action: With one hand, pull forward and lift upward on the barrel. The barrel and receiver assembly lifts out of the stock.
steps.prose: Lift, do not pry. If it will not come, check the takedown pin is fully out.
steps.quote: With one hand, pull forward and lift upward on barrel
steps.cite: Deluxe Mark XXII Tubular Model — Undated folded instruction sheet with "PARTS DESCRIPTION FOR MARK XXII TUBULAR MODEL" (PDF p.4) — DISASSEMBLY, PDF p.2

steps.title: Field strip complete
steps.action: The barrel and receiver assembly is out of the stock, with the inner magazine tube and the takedown pin beside it. The sheet stops here.
steps.prose: The hammer, trigger and selector assemblies stay as they are: taking them apart is for a competent gunsmith or Weatherby's factory, in the sheet's own words.
steps.quote: NO FURTHER DISASSEMBLY IS NECESSARY OR RECOMMENDED.
steps.cite: Deluxe Mark XXII Tubular Model — Undated folded instruction sheet with "PARTS DESCRIPTION FOR MARK XXII TUBULAR MODEL" (PDF p.4) — DISASSEMBLY, PDF p.2
steps.warn: Disassembly of the hammer, trigger and selector assemblies should only be performed by a competent gunsmith or at our factory.

steps.title: Bore from the muzzle: solvent, dry patch, oiled patch
steps.action: With the operating handle pulled back and the bolt left open, put the cleaning rod in from the muzzle and run a bristle brush or a cloth patch wet with solvent through the bore. Follow with a dry patch, then a lightly oiled patch.
steps.prose: The sheet cleans this bore from the muzzle. Go gently at the crown.
steps.quote: Pull back operating handle and leave bolt open.
steps.cite: Deluxe Mark XXII Tubular Model — Undated folded instruction sheet with "PARTS DESCRIPTION FOR MARK XXII TUBULAR MODEL" (PDF p.4) — TO CLEAN BORE, PDF p.1

steps.title: Bolt face: solvent, dry cloth, a slightly oiled cloth
steps.action: Clean the face of the bolt with a brush or cloth wet with solvent, then a dry cloth, then a slightly oiled cloth.
steps.prose: A slightly oiled cloth means slightly. Oil that pools in an autoloader's action holds the fouling the sheet warns about.
steps.quote: Clean face of bolt with brush or cloth saturated with solvent followed by dry cloth, then slightly oiled cloth.
steps.cite: Deluxe Mark XXII Tubular Model — Undated folded instruction sheet with "PARTS DESCRIPTION FOR MARK XXII TUBULAR MODEL" (PDF p.4) — TO CLEAN BOLT, PDF p.1

steps.title: Underside of the bolt, receiver recess, hammer and selector
steps.action: With the action out of the stock, clean the underside of the bolt and the receiver recess, and the hammer and selector assemblies where they sit.
steps.prose: Clean them in place. They do not come apart on the bench.
steps.quote: The underside of the bolt and receiver recess may be cleaned as well as the hammer and selector assemblies.
steps.cite: Deluxe Mark XXII Tubular Model — Undated folded instruction sheet with "PARTS DESCRIPTION FOR MARK XXII TUBULAR MODEL" (PDF p.4) — DISASSEMBLY, PDF p.2

steps.title: Metal wiped with a lightly oiled cloth, stock with silicone
steps.action: Wipe the outside of the metal parts with a lightly oiled cloth or a silicone cloth. Wipe the stock with a silicone cloth.
steps.prose: Last, so your hands leave nothing on the finish.
steps.quote: Wipe exterior of metal parts with lightly oiled cloth or silicone cloth.
steps.cite: Deluxe Mark XXII Tubular Model — Undated folded instruction sheet with "PARTS DESCRIPTION FOR MARK XXII TUBULAR MODEL" (PDF p.4) — TO CLEAN BOLT, PDF p.1

deepAbsentReason: The tubular Mark XXII sheet ends at field disassembly. With the barrel and receiver out of the stock it says no further disassembly is necessary or recommended, and that the hammer, trigger and selector assemblies are taken apart only by a competent gunsmith or at Weatherby's factory (PDF p.2). Everything the sheet publishes is in this guide; there is no deeper procedure to follow.

reassembly: No ammunition on the bench. Inner magazine tube stays out until the end.
Barrel and receiver: set them carefully into the stock slightly forward of their normal seat. They will not seat fully yet.
Bolt: with one hand, pull it completely rearward and hold it.
Push the barrel down into the stock until it is completely seated, and move it rearward until the hole in the receiver lines up with the hole in the safety block. Release the bolt.
Takedown pin: insert it from the left side of the receiver and press it in until it is completely seated.
Inner magazine tube: put it back into the outer magazine tube and lock it with the knurled knob.
fncheck: The sheet publishes no separate function check. Inner magazine tube empty, chamber and action proved empty, muzzle in a safe direction. Pull the safety back so the S shows, then push it forward to cover the S, and back to SAFE: it should move cleanly between the two. Work the bolt by hand: it should run back and close freely. Turn the knurled knob: the inner tube should lock in the outer tube. If anything binds, or the takedown pin will not seat completely, stop and take the rifle to a competent gunsmith or Weatherby.
